_comment: Three rounds of one class whose sites share nothing but Node builtins: `path` written bare, `node:fs` prefixed and in builtinModules, and `node:test` prefixed and NOT in builtinModules on either runtime. A builtin is not a seam — no shared write/wake/read primitive lives there — and a class seamed on one could never be lifted by a diff, only by the trailer. It must come out seamless, which means reported and not gated.

The row is read before the await and `doThing` runs after it, so a concurrent archive wins the race and nothing revalidates the row in between.
